segments.name: Ecoservices
products: Virgin sulfuric acid derivatives for industrial production
Virgin sulfuric acid derivatives for nylon production
segments.description: Ecoservices provides virgin and regenerated sulfuric acid, regeneration services and hazardous waste treatment to North American refineries and industrial customers.
segments.evidence: The Company has identified one reporting unit and one reporting segment, Ecoservices, as of December 31, 2025.

revenueModel.text: Refiners, mining, industrial and automotive customers pay for sulfuric acid products, regeneration services, waste treatment and catalyst activation, largely under long-term contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: We are a leading provider of sulfuric acid recycling ("regeneration services") and end-to-end logistics to North American refineries to support the production of alkylate, a high value gasoline blending component required for meeting gasoline specifications and producing premium grade fuel.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company sold its Advanced Materials & Catalysts segment to Technip Energies N.V., leaving one reportable segment.
changes.evidence: Effective on December 31, 2025, we completed the sale of our Advanced Materials & Catalysts segment, which includes our investment in affiliated companies, Zeolyst International and Zeolyst C.V. (collectively, the "Zeolyst Joint Venture") to Technip Energies N.V. for a purchase price of $556.0 million, subject to certain adjustments set forth in the agreement.
